bug.title: Report a bug
bug.description: Tell us what went wrong. Your app version, platform and current page are attached automatically. Nothing from your vault is ever included.
bug.placeholder: What happened, and what did you expect instead?

prompt.title: Enjoying zcrypt?
prompt.body: A sentence or two helps more than you would think. It takes under a minute.

0.title: Find anything fast
0.content: Type to filter your files and folders. Press / from anywhere to jump here.

1.title: Add your files
1.content: Upload files here. They are encrypted on your device before they go anywhere. On a phone, use the plus button.

2.title: Keep things tidy
2.content: Make a new folder to organize your files. You can drag files into it later.

3.title: Every file has a menu
3.content: Right-click a file, or long-press on a phone, to share, move, rename or delete it.

4.title: Lock and unlock
4.content: This is your vault lock. Unlock it with your passphrase to open files, and lock it again when you are done.

5.title: Spaces
5.content: Share a folder with people you invite, still end-to-end encrypted.

6.title: Insights
6.content: See how much storage you use and what your vault has been up to.

0.title: Add a password
0.content: Turn this on and anyone opening the link will need the password too.

1.title: Set an expiry
1.content: Pick when the link stops working. After that, nobody can open it.

2.title: Make the link
2.content: When you are happy with the options, create your link.

0.title: Copy your link
0.content: Copy it and send it to whoever you like. Keep the whole link, including the part after the #.

0.title: Welcome to Spaces
0.content: A space is a shared folder that only the people you invite can open. Everything stays end-to-end encrypted.

1.title: Start a space
1.content: Create one, name it, and invite people. You choose who can edit and who can only view.

2.title: Your spaces live here
2.content: Open any space to add files, manage members or revoke access.
